description: This file contains unit tests for the PatientState class in the OpenMRS project. It includes tests for the getActive method and compareTo method, focusing on date range logic and ordering of patient states.

classes.name: PatientStateTest
classes.description: Test class for the PatientState entity, focusing on activity status and comparison logic based on date ranges and voided status.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Initializes date objects to be used in test cases, setting up time ranges relative to the current date.

methods.name: getActive_shouldReturnFalseIfVoidedAndDateInRange
methods.description: Tests that a voided PatientState is inactive regardless of date.

methods.name: getActive_shouldReturnFalseIfVoidedAndDateNotInRange
methods.description: Tests that a voided PatientState is inactive when tested with a date outside its range.

methods.name: getActive_shouldReturnTrueIfNotVoidedAndDateInRange
methods.description: Verifies that a non-voided PatientState is active when the date is within its range.

methods.name: getActive_shouldReturnTrueIfNotVoidedAndDateInRangeWithNullStartDate
methods.description: Checks that absence of start date considers the state active if other conditions are met.

methods.name: getActive_shouldReturnTrueIfNotVoidedAndDateInRangeWithNullEndDate
methods.description: Checks that absence of end date considers the state active if other conditions are met.

methods.name: getActive_shouldReturnTrueIfNotVoidedAndBothStartDateAndEndDateNulled
methods.description: Tests that a PatientState with null start and end dates is always considered active if not voided.

methods.name: getActive_shouldCompareWithCurrentDateIfDateNull
methods.description: Tests default behavior when the date for activity check is null, using the current date.

methods.name: getActive_shouldReturnFalseIfNotVoidedAndDateEarlierThanStartDate
methods.description: Verifies the activity status when the test date is before the start date.

methods.name: getActive_shouldReturnFalseIfNotVoidedAndDateLaterThanEndDate
methods.description: Verifies the activity status when the test date is after the end date.

methods.name: compareTo_shouldReturnPositiveIfStartDatesEqualAndThisEndDateNull
methods.description: Tests comparison when two states share the same start date, but one has a null end date.

methods.name: compareTo_shouldReturnNegativeIfThisStartDateNull
methods.description: Tests comparison when the current state has a null start date, expecting it to be ordered before.

methods.name: compareTo_shouldPassIfTwoStatesHaveTheSameStartDateEndDateAndUuid
methods.description: Verifies that two identical states compare as equal.

methods.name: compareTo_shouldReturnPositiveOrNegativeIfTwoStatesHaveTheSameStartDatesEndDatesAndUuids
methods.description: Ensures proper ordering when start date, end date, and UUID differ.
